title: base64 line-folding logic duplicated in sign.rs wrap_base64 and encrypt.rs build_mime
description: sign.rs lines 359-369 (wrap_base64) and encrypt.rs lines 487-493 (build_mime folding loop) implement the same operation: fold a base64 string at N chars per line with CRLF. They differ only in the line width (76 vs 76) and whether the trailing CRLF is included. Both use the same .chunks(width).collect::<Vec<_>>().join() or push_str pattern. A shared internal helper (e.g. in a new util.rs or inline in a common module) would eliminate the duplication. Suggested rewrite: extract fn fold_base64(b64: &str, width: usize) -> String into an internal module.
close_reason: P3 opinion/style: no correctness issue, deferred.
